value.title: The Weight of Resolve
value.synopsis: As the battle heats up, Wang Ben grows frustrated with the role his father has assigned to the Yu Feng Force.

value.title: Descendants of the Quanrong
value.synopsis: Wang Ben confronts Mǎ Nanci. The Zhao army seeks help in their battle against Yang Duanhe's mountain army.

value.title: The One-Hit-Kill Detached Force
value.synopsis: The tides of battle turn as the Fei Xin Force makes their move. Meng Tian joins Xin on a crucial side mission.
